readme.run: Extract a skull-stripped rodent brain image and binary brain mask
notes: Model weights are compiled into the bundled brainchomp-lib CPU WebAssembly module.
No network connection or previously populated cache is required.
Input headers must carry real rodent voxel sizes (e.g. 0.1 mm, not x10 human-scaled).
Add --opening R (0..64, default 4) to tune morphological opening, --no-fill-holes to keep
internal cavities, --threads N for CPU threads, or --help for all options.
Interactive quadruped reorientation, DICOM import and mask editing use the web app.
Brainchomp is research software; inspect extracted masks before quantitative analysis.
